notes.title: "Guangzhou Poker" New Product Festival Live Broadcast
notes.content:
The difference between the Demo version and the official version is that the number of "joker cards" is limited. The Demo version has 16 joker cards, while the official version has 52.

Game Introduction
This is a turn-based strategy game with poker themes. Each poker card has a specific skill mechanism. You can also devour poker cards to gain new skills, gather high-scoring cards, and defeat enemies from different time and space (even yourself)

Game Features
1. Card type duel based on "Texas Hold'em"
Using poker cards as the prototype, the points of poker cards are increased based on the card type, and the cards of both sides compete by competing for points.

2. Devouring evolution
Each poker card has skills with different mechanisms, and you can also buy poker cards to devour. Successful devouring increases the number of skills.

3. Joker card relics
By building different relics, you can experience more genres.

4. Asynchronous duel
Your opponent is not an ordinary AI, but a player from different time and space, or even yourself.
